title: Ciphertext-only structure prior
rationale: This lane predeclares a ciphertext-only position prior before scoring any source-backed observations. It is not another public-anchor mining pass because discovery uses only K4 ciphertext repeated-ngram gap factors, shifted ciphertext coincidences, and seeded letter-shuffle diagnostics; public anchor positions are used only to exclude anchor ranges from future residue targets.
prediction_target: Future source-reviewed non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched in the predeclared ciphertext-derived residue classes for the selected periods only if they beat same-size non-anchor position-shuffle, selected-period, and multiple-comparison controls.
discovery_inputs: Repeated n-gram gap-factor profile over ciphertext positions
Shifted ciphertext coincidence profile over ciphertext positions
Seeded letter-shuffle diagnostics preserving the K4 ciphertext letter multiset
Known solved clue positions used only as an exclusion mask for future non-anchor targets
evaluation_inputs: Future source-reviewed non-anchor K4 position observations selected before scoring
Observation files with per-position source notes and validation against the registered non-anchor universe
Independent target positions that are not public known-plaintext anchor fragments and are not derived from anchor additive-key values
controls: seeded ciphertext letter-shuffle diagnostics for selecting weak prior periods
seeded same-size non-anchor position-shuffle baseline for observation scoring
promotion blocked unless future independent observations beat all predeclared controls without post-hoc retuning
